---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Muchhad Quiz
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits? (Teachers, students, trainers, etc.)

## 💭 Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like it to work. Include:
- User flow
- UI/UX considerations
- API changes (if any)
- Database changes (if any)

## 🎨 Design Considerations

- [ ] Follows neo-brutalist design system
- [ ] Uses design tokens (no hardcoded colors)
- [ ] Accessible (WCAG AA)
- [ ] Dark mode compatible
- [ ] Mobile responsive
- [ ] i18n ready (English, Hindi, Gujarati)

## 📱 Platforms Affected

- [ ] Frontend (React)
- [ ] Backend (Node.js/Express)
- [ ] Real-time (Socket.IO)
- [ ] Database (PostgreSQL)
- [ ] Cache (Redis)
- [ ] Docker/Deployment

## 📊 Success Metrics

How do we measure if this feature works?
- [ ] User adoption (% of games using it)
- [ ] Performance (latency, throughput)
- [ ] Teacher feedback (qualitative)
- [ ] Student engagement

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they weren't chosen.

## 📚 Additional Context

Mockups, references, similar features in other tools, research links.

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I've searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] This aligns with the project's teacher-first mission
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement or test this feature
- [ ] This doesn't compromise the "free forever, no tracking" promise
